## How it works

<h3>Inspect levels</h3><p>Toggle a storey to show or hide its components. Unassigned components have their own option. This example changes visibility; it does not cut the model. Select a component, then click <strong>1 element selected</strong> at the top left to open Properties.</p><h3>Developer integration</h3><p>The component identifiers, names and storey memberships are queried through the native <code>viewer.IfcAPI</code>. The original architectural IFC4 file is hash-verified and imported unchanged. BCF views are written with <code>bcf.save()</code>, imported with <code>viewer.add()</code>, and applied with <code>viewer.selectTopic()</code>. Open <strong>Topics</strong> (speech bubble) on the left toolbar to inspect the generated viewpoint.</p><p>The spatial tree supplies level names and element membership. Components nested in spaces or assemblies inherit the enclosing storey.</p><p>The page opens the original source bytes with <code>await viewer.IfcAPI</code>, reads native model data, then closes the model and disposes WASM before displaying the source with <code>viewer.add()</code>. See the <a href="https://thatopen.github.io/engine_web-ifc/docs/classes/web-ifc.IfcAPI.html">complete web-ifc API reference</a>.</p>
